announcements.title: Welcome to CS F342 Lab
announcements.body: This portal is the official home for P4 and P7 lab material. Bookmark it and check the latest notice before each session.

announcements.title: Lab sheets will appear here
announcements.body: Downloads will be published as they are released. A sheet marked ‘Coming soon’ is not yet available.

labs.title: Lab sheet 2

policies.title: Before the lab
policies.text: Read the current lab sheet, complete any pre-lab work, and bring the required files to your assigned session.

policies.title: During the lab
policies.text: Work in your assigned section and follow the submission instructions given for that experiment.

policies.title: Getting help
policies.text: Raise questions during your session or use the instructor contact channel announced in class.
